subject: Hosted API evaluation — slot negotiation & preflight
messages:
From: Sam Park <sam@cartflow.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-11T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API evaluation — quick walkthrough request

Hi Naomi,

I signed up for the Hosted API sandbox this morning (we're CartFlow, a payments orchestration startup). I poked around the quickstart but would love a short walk-through to validate latency/cost expectations for our prototyping use case.

Prefer a 30–45 minute session next week in the afternoon (PDT). Key goals: see token/throughput numbers, prefix caching behavior for short prompts, and quick tips on embedding vs. generation tradeoffs.

Attendees: me (Sam Park, engineering lead) and Priya Ramesh (product).

Can you share availability and whether we need anything prepared on our side?

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Park
Engineering Lead, CartFlow
sam@cartflow.ai
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Park <sam@cartflow.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-11T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API evaluation — quick walkthrough request

Hi Sam — welcome and thanks for signing up. Naomi is on the PLG team and will coordinate the technical walk-through.

I can propose a few windows next week (all PDT):
- Tue 2027-08-17, 2:00–2:45pm
- Wed 2027-08-18, 3:00–3:45pm
- Thu 2027-08-19, 4:30–5:15pm

If none of those work, send two windows that do and I’ll do my best to match. Quick note: we have a short pre-demo checklist (attached) that speeds things up but it’s optional.

Calendly (if easier): https://calendly.com/redwood/sandbox-quickwalk

Best,
Diego Fernandez
SDR, Redwood Inference
From: Sam Park <sam@cartflow.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-11T11:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API evaluation — quick walkthrough request

Thanks Diego — appreciate the options.

Two quick things:
1) We actually prefer the earlier side of next week if possible — is Mon 8/16 morning available? We can do 45 minutes if that helps cover both infra and product questions.
2) Priya and I are on PDT (sorry I missed that in my first note).

If Monday won’t work for Redwood, Wed 3pm works for us.

Sam
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Park <sam@cartflow.ai>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-11T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API evaluation — quick walkthrough request

Hi Sam — Naomi here from the PLG/solutions side. Nice to meet you.

We can absolutely do a 45-minute slot on Monday 2027-08-16 AM PDT. My availability: 9:00–10:00am or 11:00–11:45am. Which is better for you?

A couple of items so we make the most of the time:
- If you can share a sample prompt or short prompt-set you plan to test, we’ll pre-run and bring concrete latency/rate guidance.
- For throughput and KV-cache behavior Marissa (cc’d) will cover model variant recommendations and batching tips.
- I attached a short guide (HostedAPI-quickwalk-guide.pdf) and a one-page pre-demo checklist. No required prep — optional only.

When you confirm a slot I’ll send a calendar invite and a sandbox token with the limited-scope exemplar workspace.

Looking forward to it,
Naomi Feldman
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.ai

Thanks — Sam confirmed 11:00–11:45am on Mon 2027-08-16 (PDT). I’ve created a provisional calendar invite (attached invite.ics) and added the Calendly link in the event notes for easy rescheduling.

Meeting details (provisional):
- When: Mon Aug 16, 2027 · 11:00–11:45am PDT
- Where: Google Meet (link in invite)
- Attendees: Sam Park (CartFlow), Priya Ramesh (CartFlow), Naomi Feldman (Redwood), Marissa Cole (Redwood), Diego Fernandez (Redwood)

Pre-demo checklist (attached) — if you can paste a 1–3 example prompts into the event or reply to this email, we’ll run them ahead of time and bring numbers. Otherwise we’ll demo typical token counts and batching guidance for short prompts.

See you Monday — I’ll send the final calendar invite after Sam accepts.

Diego
